title: AvePoint, Inc. (NASDAQ: AVPT) — Institutional Business Monograph & Stage 2 Investment Dossier
archetype: Cloud Data Resilience & AI Governance SaaS Compounder
primer: AvePoint (NASDAQ: AVPT) earns a Compounder Pass on its 80%-SaaS data protection platform, delivering $495.1M ARR (+25% FX-adjusted), 111% NRR, $418.3M cash, and $144.5M North America 9M revenue [2, 3, 4]. However, Pass 1 forensics revealed 58.1x TTM (63.6x annualized 9M26) ex-SBC FCF, +35.8% hosting cost growth, -520 bps Q3 margin compression, and Microsoft Agent 365 overlap [2, 3, 28]. Because $19.25 Base upside (+16.7%) yields only 0.73:1 R:R inside a 10-distribution-day Downtrend (3.38% US cash vs. 22.0% floor), new capital is REJECTED (TIER_0, VALUATION). We trim 76.6 of our 153.2332 Schwab shares (~50%) immediately into USD cash and raise the stop on the remaining 76.6332 shares to $15.05 (1.92:1 R:R).
holding_rationale: This Schwab stake sits just +1.07% (+$26.82) in profit inside a 10-distribution-day Downtrend. US portfolio cash is only 3.38% ($2,540.35) vs. the 22.0% floor, while effective S&P 500 exposure sits at 234.2%. Reconciling S9.1 and S11, AVPT carries a 1.07 five-year Finviz beta alongside a 0.69 1-year realized beta. Neither beta grants a defensive pass at 58.1x TTM (63.6x annualized) ex-SBC FCF. We shift to TRIM_INTO_STRENGTH and sell 76.6 shares (~50%, ~$1,263.13) into cash now. That trims weight from 3.36% to 1.68% and lifts portfolio cash toward 5.06%. On the remaining 76.6332 shares, we ratchet the stop UP from $12.68 to $15.05 ($0.13 below the rising 50D SMA $15.18). Residual risk drops to -$110.35 (-8.7%, or 0.15% of NAV) against +16.7% upside to $19.25, earning a 1.92:1 R:R.
